limitations: The first five seconds are excluded by display filter; later matched startup traffic is separately excluded from setting comparisons.
Candidate report bytes come from separate VirtualBox control-phase setup slots, not a complete ordinary USBPcap payload stream.
Captured lengths are shorter than original lengths in many records. Do not reconstruct missing bytes.
UI action attribution uses operator confirmation and distinct bursts; exact click timestamp was not recorded.

The block/offset fields are protocol coordinates, not proven physical device memory addresses.
No Linux command or captured report was replayed to the mouse.
